# Temple Scroll Column 65 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 65 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**65:1** The Levitical priests — the entire tribe of Levi — shall have no allotment or inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the fire offerings of the LORD and his inheritance.

**65:2** They shall have no inheritance among their brothers; the LORD himself is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.

**65:3** This shall be the rightful due of the priests from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether ox or sheep: they shall give the priest the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the stomach.

**65:4** The firstfruits of your grain, your new wine, and your oil, and the first of the shearing of your flock, you shall give to him.

**65:5** For the LORD your God has chosen him from all your tribes to stand and minister in the name of the LORD — him and his sons — for all time.

**65:6** If a Levite comes from any of your towns throughout Israel where he has been residing, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place that I shall choose,

**65:7** he may minister in the name of the LORD his God alongside all his fellow Levites who stand there before me.

**65:8** They shall eat equal portions, irrespective of what any may have received from the sale of family property.

**65:9** When you enter the land that I am giving you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominable practices of those nations.

**65:10** No one shall be found among you who passes a son or daughter through fire, who practices divination, who reads omens, who interprets signs, or who practices sorcery,

**65:11** or who casts spells, or who consults ghosts or familiar spirits, or who inquires of the dead.

**65:12** For everyone who does these things is an abomination to the LORD, and it is because of these abominations that the LORD your God is driving them out before you.

**65:13** You shall be whole-hearted with the LORD your God.

**65:14** For these nations you are about to dispossess give heed to those who read omens and practice divination, but the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so.

**65:15** The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet from among your own people, from your brothers, like me; you shall heed him.

**65:16** This accords with what you requested of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, when you said: Let us not hear the voice of the LORD our God again, nor see this great fire any more, or we shall die.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Council used LOGOS as baseline with key EMET readings. "Cheeks" (EMET) preferred over "jowls" (LOGOS) and "jawbones" (PNEUMA) — the traditional biblical rendering is well established. "Whole-hearted" (EMET) preferred over "wholly devoted" (LOGOS) and "completely faithful" (PNEUMA) for תמים — this captures the Hebrew sense of relational completeness. "Fire offerings" (EMET) retained as more literal than LOGOS's paraphrase. "Familiar spirits" added alongside "ghosts" per EMET. The prophet-like-Moses passage rendered with elevated register befitting its messianic significance.*
